QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Fever Medicine
QuestInfo.0: You told Loha that Crawls with Balrog has high fever. Check with Loha again about the Fever Medicine.
QuestInfo.1: Loha doesn't have any medicine at the moment, and asked you to see Perzen for some help.\nExplain the situation to Perzen and ask if he could make some Fever Medicine.
QuestInfo.2: Explain the situation to Perzen and ask if he could make some Fever Medicine.

0.0: Where did I put it? I thought I had some Fever Medicine...
0.1: Ooh, maybe there was still some snail poison in the porridge... And I have no medicine! What should we do...? Umm, umm... Perzen might be able to help.

yes.0: Hurry, hurry! Tell Perzen about Crawls with Balrog's symptoms, and ask how to reduce the fever.

no.0: What are you doing? NOW is the time to be helpful! You're just going to leave the poor child like that?

1.0: So, are you enjoying our little camp? It's dark, and quiet, and man-eating snails only break in occasionally...\r\n#L0##bThat's not important right now! Crawls with Balrog has a terrible fever, and we have no medicine for him!#l\n#k
1.1: Right, okay, first, deep breath. Calm down, and explain the situation. Details are good.\r\n#L0##bOkay... Crawls with Balrog ate some Snail Porridge, and came down with a high fever soon after. He's breaking out in rashes, too. Since we have no medicine, I was hoping you could help.#l\n#k
1.2: Were there any other symptoms? Like nausea, or...?\r\n#L0##bHmm... I don't recall anything like that.#l\n#k

npc.0: Hurry! Ask Perzen about how to bring down his fever.
